- Skeletal Cleric: Quality now provides Revived Skeletons are immune to damage for 0-3 seconds after being revived, instead of 0-30% more Maximum Minion Life.
* Fixed a bug where Skeletal Cleric s would fail to follow the player.
* The Life threshold Skeletal Arsonist s can target other Minions, and the heal amount of Skeletal Clerics has been adjusted proportionately to the Minion Life changes.
- Adjusted Skeletal Cleric's Heal Life scaling accordingly. - Improved Skeletal Cleric behaviour to reduce cases where they would run at enemies and attempt to attack them.
